overview: Central India's best tiger country (Kanha or Pench) paired with the UNESCO-listed carved temples of Khajuraho.
fit: Safaris are great for the 10-year-old. Check the minimum age for safaris (usually 5+ in many parks), and plan a resort with activities for the 4-year-old.
season: Parks are open mid-October to June; closed in monsoon (July–September). Nov–Feb is pleasant but early safaris are very cold; March–April gives the best tiger sightings but is hot.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Nagpur (Pench 2 hr, Kanha 5 hr) or Jabalpur (Kanha 4 hr)
Kanha to Khajuraho is a long drive (8 hr); consider Pench + Nagpur only
